description: This file defines the 'BlackfireDumper' class in the Twig Profiler namespace, responsible for generating a Blackfire-compatible profiling output from a Profile object. It includes methods for dumping profile data, recursively processing child profiles, and accumulating profiling metrics.

classes.name: BlackfireDumper
classes.description: A final class responsible for dumping profiling data in the Blackfire format, including methods for profiling data traversal and formatting.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Generates a Blackfire-formatted profiling report from a Profile object.

methods.name: dumpChildren
methods.description: Recursively processes child profiles to include their data in the dump, constructing hierarchical profile edges.

methods.name: dumpProfile
methods.description: Accumulates profiling metrics for a given profile and edge, updating the data array.
